public_rationale: The records show limited but growing broad AI adoption and a substantial projected loss at OpenAI. Neither establishes the compound claim. The unspecified accounting basis also prevents a financial verdict.
limitations: US broad-AI adoption is only context for corporate generative-AI adoption.
The financial evidence is a forecast for one company, with an explicit expense exclusion.
Changing the company universe or meaning of adoption could change the answer.
